en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Kufy, from Hamdan Al Qalanasy, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban, from Aamir Bin Abdullah Bin Juza’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no one who would recite the end (Verse) of (Surah) Al Kahf (Chapter 18) (before going to sleep) except he would wake up during the time which he wanted to’.
en.sarwar: 17. Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi has narrated from Hamdan al-Qalanisi from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Aban from ‘Amir ibn ‘Ubayd Allah ibn Judha’a from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever recites verse 110 of Chapter 18 he will wake up at the hour he wants to wake up.”
